content: Welcome to Kainro. By accessing our website or using our gardening services, you agree to the following terms. These terms are designed to keep everything clear, fair, and transparent for both you and our team.

Kainro provides gardening and outdoor maintenance services designed to care for and improve your space. By booking or using our services, you agree to provide accurate information and ensure safe access to your property when required.

  • You must provide correct contact and service details.
  • You are responsible for ensuring access to your garden at the scheduled time.
  • Any special conditions or risks should be communicated in advance.

We reserve the right to refuse or reschedule services if conditions are unsafe or unclear.

All services must be scheduled in advance through our website or by contacting our team. Once a booking is confirmed, we will allocate time and resources accordingly. You may request to reschedule or cancel a booking with prior notice. Last-minute cancellations may affect future availability or result in service adjustment depending on the situation.

We aim to be flexible, but also value the time and planning of both our team and our clients.

Our pricing is based on the size of your garden, the type of service required, and the frequency of maintenance. Quotes are provided clearly before any work begins.

  • Payments must be made through approved methods.
  • Emergency services may follow a separate payment structure.
  • Additional work outside the agreed scope may be charged separately.

We ensure full transparency—no hidden fees or unexpected charges.

Kainro provides professional care based on experience and best practices. However, gardening is influenced by natural factors beyond our control.

We do not guarantee specific outcomes related to plant growth, weather conditions, or environmental changes. While we aim for the best results, nature plays a role in long-term garden success and the final appearance may vary according to seasonal conditions.

To deliver our services efficiently, we may require access to your outdoor spaces in your absence. We treat every property with care and respect.

  • You are responsible for securing pets and notifying us of hazards.
  • We are not liable for pre-existing damage or hidden risks.
  • Any fragile or valuable items should be safely stored beforehand.

We aim to leave every garden cleaner, safer, and better than we found it.

We understand that plans change. You may cancel or reschedule services with reasonable notice. Refunds are considered based on the nature of the service and the timing of the cancellation. Completed services are generally non-refundable, but we always strive to resolve concerns fairly.

Our goal is to maintain trust, not rigid policies.

By using our website, you agree not to misuse its content or functionality. All materials, including text, designs, and branding, belong to Kainro unless stated otherwise. You may not copy, reproduce, or distribute any part of the website without permission.

While we take every precaution to deliver high-quality service, Kainro is not liable for indirect, incidental, or unforeseen damages resulting from services.

Our responsibility is limited to the value of the service provided, and we always aim to resolve issues in a fair and reasonable way.

We may update these Terms & Conditions as our services evolve. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated effective date. Continued use of our services means you accept the latest version of these terms.

We may update this Privacy Policy occasionally to align with changes in our services or legal requirements. All updates will be clearly displayed on this page. The revised effective date will also be shown alongside the changes for your reference.

If you have any questions or concerns about this Terms & Conditions or how our services operate, our team is here to help.
